rules: Use natural coffee terminology for the target locale, not literal word-by-word translation.
Preserve model names, model codes, quoted evidence, brand names and the original editorial assessment.
Preserve all numeric facts and original currency references. Never invent exchange-rate conversions, regional prices, local testing, warranties, electrical specifications or model equivalence.
Translate legal text faithfully; do not invent jurisdiction-specific rights or compliance claims.
Use European Portuguese for pt-PT and Brazilian Portuguese for pt-BR.
Use Canadian French for fr-CA and France French for fr-FR.
Use Swiss Standard German for de-CH, including ss instead of ß where appropriate.
Use neutral Latin American Spanish for es-419. Do not assume all countries use Mexico's currency or electrical standards.
For English regional editions, adapt spelling and wording without changing documented source-market facts.
